program.name: Balanced 30
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: Half an hour, no equipment: bodyweight strength, a burst of cardio and a flow, every day.
program.about: Half an hour with nothing but a mat: bodyweight strength, a burst of cardio and a flow, all in one session. One day is a strength circuit, an EMOM and a yoga flow, one is push-ups and rows, an AMRAP and a stretch, and the third is legs, a Tabata and a hip flow. Levels II and III add reps in the strength and cardio, and each hold in the flows gets longer. The shortest way to cover everything in a day.
program.split: Circuit, EMOM & yoga / push-pull, AMRAP & stretch / legs, Tabata & hips
program.gear: A mat, and a sturdy table for the rows.
